**Repair only.** One playthrough of the Knights of Saladin route, and what it found. Nothing new.

## Amir had nothing to say

Win the Dream Djinni's trials and Amir names you a Favored One -- and then, on this mod as well
as vanilla, offered you nothing. 0.7.0 restored his Montserrat directions, but put them on the
greeting he uses for strangers, not the one he uses for a Favored One. You could never see them.
They are now where he actually says them.

## The trials were stripping your order

The deeper problem, and it was mine. A character in this game holds **one** faction. Assigning
another replaces it, and the old one's rank and bonuses go with it. Two earlier releases assumed
otherwise -- that a Templar or an Inquisitor could also be a Knight of Saladin -- and so winning
the trials quietly unmade a sworn Inquisitor or Templar, and their next promotion quietly unmade
the Knight. A tester's saves showed both, in order.

So Saladin content now keys on the **title**, not the faction. Take the trials and you are a
Favored One whatever order you serve; Amir treats you as one, the Knights of Saladin greet you
as one, and your own order is untouched. A character with no order at all still becomes a
Knight of Saladin outright, bonuses included -- the trials only decline to replace an order you
already hold.

What this does not change: the late-game relic still promotes the order you actually serve, and
the Cathedral council still convenes the order that sent you north. The Knights of Saladin's own
council plays for a character who went north through Amir and no one else.

## Installing

Download, unzip, run `Mod Manager.bat`. It installs over 0.8.2 as normal.

Amir's fix is dialogue and takes effect on any save. The Knights' greeting and the trials
change are map-side and need a character who has not yet entered the Gate District -- and a
character already stripped of an order by the old trials cannot get it back from this.
